brick-wall-001.description: Photogrammetry color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps used on the masonry surrounding the storefronts

downtown-characters.description: Game-rigged characters with locally authored caps, apron, spectacles, idle, walk, boarding and disembarking from either door, steering, greeting and service animations, and silk-folding and fitted MPFB expression targets for the counter staff
downtown-characters.clothingCredit: Margaret Toigo and the MakeHuman Community

walker-window-suits.description: Original window forms made from the fitted CC0 downtown suits, with carved wooden necks and woven navy serge and tobacco herringbone finishes

counter-voices.description: Original shop dialogue synthesized locally from the game's lines, with phoneme timings for the character rigs

brown-marx-brick.description: Buff brick color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps photographed by Rob Tuytel

ledger-kiosk.description: Original wood, zinc and canvas kiosk, folded newspaper and newsprint artwork. The 1928 headline comes from the game's existing edition.

landmark-stone-grain.description: Photographed color, normal and roughness maps by Dimitrios Savva, tinted for the cast stone on the two landmark facades

landmark-architecture.description: Original game geometry for all four Heaviest Corner towers and the Brown-Marx lobby, informed by the historic district survey

marble-counter.description: Marble color, normal and roughness photographed by Rob Tuytel

wood-cabinetry.description: Fine-grained wood color, normal and roughness photographed by Rob Tuytel
